newsitem.title: USA: Lancer Corp says it buys New Zealand co.
newsitem.headline: Lancer Corp says it buys New Zealand co.

text.p: Lancer Corp said Thursday it has completed the purchase of Applied Beverage Systems Ltd, a New Zealand-based company.
The company said it bought Applied for a combination of cash and 81,888 shares of Lancer stock.
The company declined to disclose the amount of cash it paid in the deal. It said the stock was valued at about $1.64 million based on Wednesday's closing price of $20.00 per share.
The company said it will account for the purchase under purchase accounting rules.
The company said Applied makes and distributes fountain soft drink and beer dispensing equipment. It had 1996 sales of about $8 million.
